# A S Plastics

> Tool room and mould manufacturer in SICOF, Satpur MIDC, Nashik, Maharashtra, India. Established 2015. Proprietor: Azharuddin Sheikh.

All types of tool room work, moulding job works and mould maintenance.

## Services
- Injection moulding dies (phone case dies, PET components, industrial plastic parts)
- Plastic mould dies (caps, closures, egg trays, multi-cavity moulds)
- Heavy VMC / CNC machining (die machining, steel cavities, industrial components)
- Mould base manufacturing and tool room job works
- Die casting moulds, PET preform mould components, toy moulds
- Mould maintenance and repair
